notes.title: Cotropitorii is now FREE to play!
notes.content:
Have you always wanted to invade the United States as a Romanian communist soldier but found the $2.99 pricetag too expensive? Well, wonder no more, because Cotropitorii -- the premiere US-invading FPS game -- is now free-to-play!

Download Cotropitorii today and test your skills against your friends in this multiplayer shooter game. Remember to wire up GameRanger or Hamachi to get IP-to-IP multiplayer working. If you do manage to jump this hurdle, lay waste to your opponents in the single map the game ships with.

If enough people play it, we can even get on the Steam concurrent players list!

notes.title: Let's get trading cards.
notes.content:
Thanks to the fact that this is a 14 year old game, that nobody in their right mind would ever play, we have not unlocked trading card functionality. This is bad because we put all that effort in actually having trading cards and emoticons and everything else.

So you, our community, can get in and help us: play the game and tell your friends to play it too. Let's get the communists going again... and what better way to display our support of dictatorships than by having a Steam badge, a background profile image or emoticons on display.

Get out there and play Cotropitorii!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Are you itching to shoot at Romanians or Americans? Well, you can now do it with 75% off!

Buy Cotropitorii during the Steam Summer sale for 75% off!

notes.title: ...and we're off!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Cotropitorii!

The game has now been released on Steam! If you like communist almost-unfinished games with local multiplayer (or roam-around single-player) be sure to check it out.
